components.html: View selected work
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 19px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.364 0.042 115.66); border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.364 0.042 115.66); color: oklch(0.792 0.0586 114.21); font: 600 14px/1 Source Sans 3, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 oklch(0.364 0.042 115.66 / 0.12); transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: oklch(0.364 0.042 115.66); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px oklch(0.364 0.042 115.66 / 0.18); } .ds-btn-primary:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.507 0.0838 115.77); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 76px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding: 0 20px; background: oklch(0.8759 0.0949 114.74 / 0.88); color: oklch(0.364 0.042 115.66); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); } .ds-wordmark { color: oklch(0.364 0.042 115.66); font: 700 14px/1 Archivo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 13px; color: oklch(0.41 0.05 115.7); font: 600 13px/1 Source Sans 3, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 13px; bottom: 8px; left: 13px; height: 1px; background: oklch(0.364 0.042 115.66); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.ds-active { color: oklch(0.364 0.042 115.66); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link.ds-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

components.name: Experience Row
components.description: An open, rule-divided work row that reveals detail without hiding the scan-friendly employer, role, and date structure.
components.css: .ds-experience-row { width: 100%; min-height: 112px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 70px minmax(0, 2fr) minmax(140px, 1fr) minmax(130px, 1fr) auto; gap: 24px; align-items: center; padding: 22px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.507 0.0838 115.77); background: transparent; color: oklch(0.364 0.042 115.66); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-experience-row:hover { background: oklch(0.792 0.0586 114.21 / 0.62); } .ds-index, .ds-date { color: oklch(0.41 0.05 115.7); font: 11px/1.4 IBM Plex Mono, monospace; } .ds-company { font: 550 clamp(24px, 2.5vw, 35px)/1.08 Archivo, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-role { color: oklch(0.41 0.05 115.7); font: 13px/1.4 Source Sans 3, sans-serif; } .ds-expand { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid oklch(0.507 0.0838 115.77); border-radius: 50%; font: 22px/1 Source Sans 3, sans-serif; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-experience-row:hover .ds-company { transform: translateX(4px); }

narrative.overview:
This visual system treats the portfolio as a field guide to work that has shipped. It is calm and precise enough for a technical reader to scan, but warm enough to keep the person behind the systems visible. The pale linden canvas, deep olive ink, oversized sans-serif headlines, and compact mono labels make the interface feel like a carefully annotated record rather than a generic startup landing page.

The composition stays spacious and editorial while the controls remain tactile. Hairline rules divide the long-form story, a dark project band gives the work a distinct chapter, and small translations, shadows, and expanding rows make interaction feel present without becoming decorative. Future screens should preserve this balance: confident structure, human copy, and evidence-first emphasis.
keyCharacteristics: Pale linden field with deep olive ink and a muted botanical accent range.
Oversized Archivo display type paired with Source Sans 3 body copy and IBM Plex Mono metadata.
Twelve-column desktop compositions, thin section rules, and generous vertical breathing room.
Pill-shaped actions with small lift and arrow motion; circular controls for compact toggles.
A dark project chapter and restrained multiply-tinted imagery that let proof carry the visual weight.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: Keep new color decisions inside the existing yellow-green/olive family unless a future product decision explicitly changes the visual world.

rules.name: The Headline-First Rule
rules.body: Let one oversized statement establish the section before supporting copy explains it; do not flatten the hierarchy into equal-sized cards or labels.

rules.name: The Chapter Rule
rules.body: Use spacing and rules to separate narrative chapters; do not turn every content block into a floating card.

rules.name: The Tactile-Only Rule
rules.body: Use elevation as feedback for an action or state, never as decoration on passive content.

dos: Do keep the pale linden, sage, deep olive, and accent-line roles coherent across new surfaces.
Do give each section one clear typographic lead and let supporting copy remain readable and human.
Do use thin rules, open layouts, and dark chapter bands to organize long-form evidence.
Do make actions feel tactile through pill geometry, clear focus, and small purposeful motion.
Do preserve the warm, technically literate voice of a field guide to shipped work.
donts: Don't introduce generic startup SaaS tropes such as glossy gradient hero treatments, glass cards, or dashboard-like UI chrome.
Don't add unrelated hues or persistent shadows that compete with the single-family palette and tonal depth.
Don't turn every experience, project, or achievement into a rounded card grid; the incumbent system is defined by open rows and rules.
Don't let the technology marquee, decorative motion, or imagery overpower the evidence and the person behind it.
